name: Madurai (Vaigai / Periyar command)

ndvi.source: NASA AppEEARS: MODIS MOD13Q1.061 250 m, 3 points, good-quality pixels

precip_source: GPM IMERG Final daily V07 at 10.05N 78.35E (0.1° grid); temperature/ET0 from NASA POWER

dry_spells.source: GPM IMERG Final daily V07 via NASA GES DISC Giovanni, 2001-2024
dry_spells.definition: longest run of days < 2.5 mm in the 30 days starting the 1st of the sowing month

ne_onset.method: first day from 10 Oct with >= 20 mm over 3 days and no 10+ day dry spell (< 2.5 mm) in the next 30 days (agro-meteorological onset; IMD's official onset uses winds and coastal stations)

sowing_rain_onset.method: same rule searching from 15 Sep: first reliable sowing rains (includes late southwest-monsoon / transition rain used for Purattasi-pattam sowing)

smap.source: NASA AppEEARS: SMAP L3 enhanced SPL3SMP_E.006, 9 km, AM pass, recommended-quality retrievals, 3 points

elevation_m.source: NASA AppEEARS: SRTMGL1_NC.003 30 m, mean of 3 points

groundwater.source: NASA GLDAS-2.2 CLSM 0.25 deg daily with GRACE data assimilation (GLDAS_CLSM025_DA1_D.2.2, doi 10.5067/TXBMLX370XX8), GWS_tavg, via Giovanni
groundwater.note: GRACE resolves ~300 km; read as regional groundwater change, not one village's wells
